title: The Weight of a UFC Knockout
text:
Introduction
Does a fighter’s weight class lead to more knockouts in the UFC?
This project goes over fights from 2016-2026, comparing the difference in fight outcomes, time and knockout rates between different weight classes. The goal is to find out if a heavier weight class is associated with more knockouts in the octagon within the last decade.

library(tidyverse)
library(gt)


ufc <- read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2026/2026-07-07/ufc_fights.csv")

ufc_project <- ufc |>
  filter(
    date>= "2016-06-27",
    date<= "2026-06-27",
    weight_class %in% c(
      "Flyweight Bout",
      "Bantamweight Bout",
      "Featherweight Bout",
      "Lightweight Bout",
      "Welterweight Bout",
      "Middleweight Bout",
      "Light Heavyweight Bout",
      "Heavyweight Bout"
    )
) |>
  select(
    event_name, date, f1_name, f2_name, weight_class, method, time, round
  )


glimpse(ufc_project)

Columns: 8

$ method       <chr> "KO/TKO", "Decision - Unanimous", "KO/TKO", "Submission",…
$ time         <chr> "15S", "5M 0S", "1M 31S", "3M 33S", "5M 0S", "3M 25S", "5…
$ round        <dbl> 2, 3, 1, 3, 3, 1, 3, 1, 1, 1, 2, 3, 3, 3, 2, 1, 1, 2, 3, …



weight_table <- ufc_project |>
  group_by(weight_class) |>
  summarise(
    total_fights = n(),
    knockouts = sum(method == "KO/TKO", na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    ko_percentage = round(knockouts / total_fights *100, 1)
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(ko_percentage))


weight_table |>
  gt() |>
  cols_label(
    weight_class = "Weight Class",
    total_fights = "Total Fights",
    knockouts = "KO/TKO Finishes",
    ko_percentage = "KO/TKO Rate (%)"
  ) |>
  tab_header(
    title = "Which UFC Weight Class has highest Knockout Rate?",
    subtitle = "KO/TKO Across all mens UFC weight classes from June 2016 - June 2026"
  ) |>
  tab_source_note(
    source_note = md("**Source:** UFCStats via TidyTuesday | **By:** Oscar Lockwood-Powell")
  ) |>
  opt_table_lines("none") |>
  tab_style(
    style = list(
      cell_fill(color = "red"),
      cell_text(color = "white")
    ),
    locations = cells_body(
      rows = ko_percentage == max(ko_percentage)
    )
  )

round_data <- ufc_project |>
  group_by(weight_class) |>
  summarise(
    total_fights = n(),
    avg_round = mean(round, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  arrange(weight_class) |>
  mutate(
    weight_limit = c(135, 145, 125, 265, 205, 155, 185, 170)
  )

round_data

ggplot(round_data, aes(x = weight_limit, y = avg_round)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, fullrange = TRUE, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(color = "red", size = 5) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = weight_class),
    hjust = 0.5,
    vjust = -1.5,
    size = 3
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Do Heavier UFC Fighters finish fights earlier?",
    subtitle = "Average final round reached across eight men's UFC weight classes, June 2016–June 2026",
    x = "Weight Class Limit (lbs)",
    y = "Average Final Round",
    caption = "Source: UFCStats via TidyTuesday | By: Oscar Lockwood-Powell"
  ) +
  expand_limits(
    x = c(100, 290),
    y = c(2.05, 2.60)
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
